The '''Iris''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Minas]] in foundries on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TORWEB">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170808|text=Cartel Market Specials: Week of August 8, 2017}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Minas Iris was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[May 4]], [[2015]] as part of the Core Worlds and Deep Core Explorer's Packs.
